# Premier Courier Services

> Locally owned medical and business courier based in Prescott, Arizona, serving Central and Northern Arizona 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays. Transports specimens, blood products, platelets, surgical trays, sterile instruments, pharmaceuticals, and confidential documents for hospitals, labs, pharmacies, physician and dental offices, sterile processing departments, law firms, and accountants. Owned and operated by Alanna Hanigan since 2014.

Premier Courier Services, LLC is a small, owner-run courier company. Drivers are meticulous and handle every item in a HIPAA-compliant manner. Customers reach the owner directly by phone at any hour; there is no answering service or dispatch center.

Service area: Yavapai County (Prescott, Prescott Valley, Chino Valley, Sedona, Cottonwood, Jerome), Coconino County (Flagstaff), Maricopa County (Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Scottsdale), Pima County (Tucson), and Mohave County (Kingman).

Contact: (928) 533-3585, alanna@premiercourieraz.com. Mailing address: P.O. Box 10762, Prescott, AZ 86304.

## Services

- Medical specimen and lab transport: specimens, blood products, platelets, time-sensitive lab pickups
- Hospital, operating room, and sterile processing runs: surgical trays, sterilized instruments, urgent supply deliveries
- Pharmacy and pharmaceutical delivery: prompt, discreet delivery of time-sensitive medications
- Physician, dental, and clinic deliveries: specimens, records, supplies, impressions, and lab work
- Legal and financial document delivery: same-day, confidential
- Airport retrievals and special requests

## Facts

- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays
- Based in Prescott, Arizona
- Owner and manager: Alanna Hanigan, since 2014
- Founded by Travis Womack; his legacy continues under Alanna's ownership
- Legal name: Premier Courier Services, LLC
